projects.title: Antarprerana
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise incubator management dashboard for tracking women-led business cohorts and KPI reporting.
projects.longDescription:
Antarprerana is an enterprise-grade project management and analytics platform built to digitize and streamline the management of a women’s entrepreneurship incubation program. It centralizes participant information, business performance, attendance, mentorship activities, documents, and program milestones that were previously managed across fragmented spreadsheets.

The platform provides a unified dashboard for managing participants across multiple incubation stages, including Bootcamp 1, Bootcamp 2, and the KTM Sprint. It includes real-time KPI dashboards, participant lifecycle management, document management, Excel-based data exchange, automated reporting, certificate generation, and QR-based certificate verification.

Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and RTK Query, the system uses a feature-sliced architecture with centralized server-state management, granular role-based access control, secure token refresh, schema-based form validation, and a mock API engine that enabled frontend development before the backend APIs were finalized.
projects.challenges: The main challenge was managing a large and constantly changing set of participant and program data without sacrificing performance or usability. We also had to implement granular RBAC, reliable authentication with automatic token refresh, complex Excel data validation, dynamic analytics, and multi-stage participant workflows. A further challenge was developing the complete frontend before the backend APIs were finalized, which was addressed through a configurable mock API engine.
projects.solutions: We transformed fragmented program data into a centralized digital management system. The platform provides role-specific dashboards, automated KPI tracking, participant lifecycle management, validated Excel imports, reporting tools, document management, and certificate verification, giving program staff a single system to monitor participants and make data-driven decisions.
contributions: Architected responsive multi-role dashboards (Super Admin, Admin, Participant) in Next.js 15 & TypeScript.
Integrated RTK Query with REST APIs for automated cache invalidation and efficient client state management.
Built participant KPI data tables with advanced filtering, sorting, and automated Excel report exports.
Developed cohort lifecycle tracking modules, milestone forms, and analytics data visualizations.
Implemented role-scoped access control and protected route architecture across all user roles.

projects.title: RapiReport
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered medical report analysis scanner with real-time health risk charts and patient consultation management.
projects.longDescription:
RapiReport is an AI-powered healthcare platform designed to make medical information more accessible and actionable. It uses OCR and AI to extract and interpret information from physical and handwritten medical reports, transforming complex clinical data into understandable health insights.

The platform combines automated medical report analysis with personalized health monitoring, risk assessment, medication planning, telemedicine, and family health management. Users can track health metrics, receive personalized recommendations, book doctor consultations, manage health records for family members, and interact with AI-powered healthcare features.

My primary contribution focused on designing and building the frontend user interface using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, integrating REST APIs, and building interactive health data visualization components.
projects.challenges: The major challenge was combining multiple complex healthcare features into one reliable platform while keeping the experience simple for users. Processing handwritten and physical medical reports required a hybrid OCR approach using both client-side and server-side processing. We also had to integrate AI-generated insights, health-risk analysis, real-time data visualization, role-based dashboards, authentication, and sensitive medical data handling while maintaining a modular and responsive frontend.
projects.solutions: RapiReport provides a unified healthcare ecosystem that converts difficult-to-understand medical documents into accessible health information using OCR and AI. It combines report analysis, personalized risk monitoring, medication planning, doctor consultations, family health records, and wellness features in a single platform, giving users a more convenient way to understand and manage their health.
contributions: Designed and built the responsive medical document upload and OCR report analysis interface.
Engineered interactive health risk visualization charts and biomarker status indicators using Recharts.
Developed patient consultation booking flow and family health records dashboard.
Integrated Gemini API response rendering with structured medical data display components.

projects.title: CultureConnect
projects.shortDescription: Cultural e-commerce marketplace & online learning platform connecting Nepalese artisans with global learners.
projects.longDescription:
CultureConnect is a community-driven platform designed to preserve and promote traditional culture by making cultural products and learning opportunities more accessible. It combines an e-commerce marketplace with a cultural learning platform where users can discover traditional products, explore courses, enroll in classes, and connect with cultural teachers and creators.

The platform supports multiple user roles, including customers, sellers, and teachers, with dedicated dashboards and functionality for each. Sellers can manage their products and sales, while teachers can create and manage courses, students, and classes. Users can browse products, manage their cart, place orders, enroll in courses, track their learning, and book classes.

I primarily contributed to the frontend development, focusing on responsive UI/UX, authentication flows, role-based interfaces, navigation, and interactive components.
projects.challenges: The main challenge was designing a simple and consistent experience for two complex systems—e-commerce and online learning. We also had to handle multiple user roles, protected routes, authentication flows, dashboards, and a large number of interactive pages while maintaining responsive design, usability, and smooth frontend performance.
projects.solutions: We created a unified digital platform that brings cultural commerce and education together. Separate role-based dashboards allow sellers and teachers to manage their respective activities, while users can seamlessly discover products, purchase cultural items, and learn traditional skills through courses and classes.
contributions: Built responsive cultural marketplace product catalog and artisan showcase interfaces.
Implemented client-side shopping cart state management, checkout flows, and order confirmation UI.
Developed e-learning course module with video player, progress tracking, and enrollment components.
Optimized layout responsiveness and asset delivery across mobile and desktop breakpoints.
